# casdoor_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor webhook, which sends the events of an organization to a URL.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_webhook" "audit" {
  name         = "webhook-acme-audit"
  organization = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  url          = "https://audit.acme.example.com/casdoor"
  method       = "POST"
  content_type = "application/json"
  events       = ["signup", "login", "logout", "update-user"]
  is_enabled   = true

  headers = [
    {
      name  = "Authorization"
      value = "Bearer ${var.audit_token}"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the webhook, unique within its owner.
- `organization` (String) The organization whose events are sent.

### Optional

- `content_type` (String) The content type of the request, `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
- `events` (List of String) The events that are sent, e.g. `signup`, `login`, `logout` or `update-user`.
- `headers` (Attributes List) The HTTP headers added to the request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `is_user_extended` (Boolean) Whether the user who triggered the event is included in the request.
- `max_retries` (Number) The number of times a failed delivery is retried.
- `method` (String) The HTTP method, e.g. `POST`.
- `object_fields` (List of String) The fields of the object included in the request, `All` includes everything.
- `retry_interval` (Number) The number of seconds between two retries.
- `single_org_only` (Boolean) Whether only events of the organization itself are sent.
- `token_fields` (List of String) The token fields included in the request.
- `url` (String) The URL that receives the events.
- `use_exponential_backoff` (Boolean) Whether the retry interval grows exponentially.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the webhook in the `owner/name` format.

<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the header.

Optional:

- `value` (String) The value of the header.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the name.
terraform import casdoor_webhook.example <name>
```
